ARENDALS FOSSEKOMPANI ASA (org.nr 910 261 525) is registered as Allmennaksjeselskap (ASA), founded 1896-01-30, registered 1995-03-12. Business address: Bøylefossveien 45, 4820 FROLAND. Main industry (NACE): 35.121 Produksjon av elektrisitet fra vannkraft. Registered employees: 42 (as of 2026-09-10). Latest filed annual accounts (2025, company statement): revenue NOK 376,207,000; operating result NOK 172,080,000; net result NOK 28,521,000; total assets NOK 6,089,884,000; equity NOK 5,192,635,000 (the group statement for the same year reports revenue NOK 3,711,239,000). Leadership: general manager (daglig leder) Benjamin Kristoffer Golding; board chair Trond Ødegård Westlie; 6 other board members. Sub-units registered: 2. Website: www.arendalsfoss.no. LEI: 5967007LIEEXZXG4U097 (ACTIVE). Wikipedia: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Arendals_Fossekompani.
